description: "A Young Girl's Wooing" by Edward Payson Roe is a novel written in the late 19th century. The story revolves around the life of Madge Alden, a young orphan raised by her elder sister and her brother-in-law, Henry Muir, in a setting marked by complex family dynamics, societal expectations, and personal struggles.
